test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e666a901f5bdc3d0ea1b8c1f65c09ca6e3fde92cb9873642297a266447832890.png] 

Logic follow here is that the first letter is decreased by 4 and second letter is decreased by 3.

Option 1) JNK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cce9c050d59eb113c8acfc7bf45096a7b4fe010d3ab042c441d2512faff691f7.png] 

Option 2) OSP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/774826d22ec38435d114110407a51ae3e0666b69c8a3bda90af9306b81a0bd4c.png] 

Option 3) TXV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a486f9bfc5f3e5543d7e338bf50c512fd23b33a6218a35a6f00b24fe638f0513.png] 

Does not follow the same logic.

Option 4) EIF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac65704a30ac662a2671341622d573abaa605c3baad4165538f68361280ec586.png] 

Hence the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
